The ground truth removes this note entirely. The generated specification also omits this erroneous instruction and correctly describes Step 2 as an HSE06 calculation without any mention of continuing the PBE XC treatment.

The generated specification likewise keeps ISTART=0 and ICHARG=0 as given, and explicitly notes 'keep ICHARG not larger than 10 and use ICHARG=0 as given,' matching the ground truth's handling of these parameters.
